about: Hand judgement, by reading each run's proposed instructions (and its own root_cause), of whether the analyst proposed an element that asks what the text is *about* (either pole: sports or workplace). This replaces the keyword screen in scripts/analyst_variance.py, which misjudged 4 of 32 valid runs. Made by one reader who knew the answer, unblinded; disagree with it in a pull request. Runs not listed are judged false.
